rule_seed_formula: 610000 + paired_model_seed * 10 + skill_index (1..5); same world IDs across arms
sample_stream: same deterministic pre-shuffled feedback order across arms for each seed and world
dataset_rng: world_seed * 1009 + split_index + 17; independent deterministic generator per split
input: 7 random features + one observable context scalar; labels and rule weights are environment-private
hidden_rule: world-specific random linear separator over seven dimensions; same task family, independent weights and bias
sealed_policy: sealed samples are separate generated feature vectors and evaluator labels are not exposed by the agent view
note: The linear task family is a minimal skill-learning test, not broad world understanding; A→E share the task family but have independent hidden weights and bias.
